name: HR Analyst Snooping on Exec Files
description: Workday integration role gives one HR analyst broad read access to compensation files. Late on a Sunday they open 27 C-suite documents in 14 minutes, pull comp histories, then save them to a personal OneDrive folder.
reasoning: The HRIS (Workday-style) and a file repository are the affected services. The simulation focuses on the access pattern: short window, off-hours, sensitive scope — even though every individual access is technically authorised.

narrative.text: Sunday 19:00 UTC. Almost no HR traffic; a couple of cron sync jobs only.
User k.chen@corp signs in from a residential IP; UEBA tags it 'unusual time, unusual location'.
Workday 'View Worker → Compensation' executed 27 times in 14 minutes against C-suite worker IDs.
Files downloaded: 9 PDFs from /Comp-Reviews-2025/; saved to a personal OneDrive folder.
Insider-risk dashboard escalates the session score to 'high'.
Manager + legal called; session revoked, device pulled, formal investigation opened.
All access revoked, audit trail preserved.
